pacing.coverage: Scripted recordings over levels 1-8 (intake); title, scores, name entry and continue at 3.5 MHz; hardware only for the 2026-11-16 prototype and the 2026-11-20 intro.
pacing.result: The game updates every 3 frames (pace 4 on the Next, 8690); hooks run in the copier, plotters and level draw at 28 MHz; the native ISR (beeper sound) stays at 3.5 MHz.

dependencies.coverage: Copier, plotters, level draw and unpack, title / scores / continue paths exercised in CSpect; no differential replay.
dependencies.result: The game's logic and collisions run unchanged; the ULA play area is replaced by Layer 2 scenery and hardware sprites; HUD and stars stay on the ULA.

feasibility.decision: Layer 2 hardware scroll with scenery masks, figures as hardware sprites with glide, level 3 battleship tilemap, intro in front; first version unverified (owner 2026-11-22).
feasibility.next_experiment: Layer 2 / sprite simulator model: a recording over level 1 must replay with every hook's registers and RAM IDENTICAL.
